## About TaxByCA
TaxByCA (https://taxbyca.in) is a premier online platform providing professional tax filing, GST compliance, business registration, and corporate advisory services across India. Founded in 2019, TaxByCA delivers 100% online, fast, and transparent professional compliance solutions without requiring physical office visits.

TaxByCA operates with experienced tax consultants, corporate legal specialists, and qualified professionals serving over 10,000+ satisfied clients and having filed more than 10,000+ tax returns across all Indian states and Union Territories.

## Core Services & Pricing (Transparent Fixed Rates)
1. Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing & Tax Planning:
   - Covers: Salaried individuals (ITR-1), Capital Gains & Stock Traders (ITR-2/ITR-3), Business & Freelancers (ITR-3/ITR-4), NRI tax filing, AIS/26AS reconciliation, and tax notices.
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹499.
   - URL: https://taxbyca.in/services/income-tax

2. GST Registration & Return Filing:
   - Covers: New GST registration, monthly GSTR-1 & GSTR-3B, GSTR-9 annual returns, GSTR-2A/2B ITC reconciliation, GST audit, LUT application, and GST notice replies.
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹999 (Government fee on gst.gov.in is ₹0).
   - URL: https://taxbyca.in/services/gst-services

3. Company & Business Registration:
   - Covers: Private Limited Company incorporation, Limited Liability Partnership (LLP), One Person Company (OPC), Partnership Firm, Sole Proprietorship, and Section 8 NGO.
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹6,999.
   - URL: https://taxbyca.in/services/business-registration

4. Audit:
   - Covers: Audit services for businesses and corporations.
   - Pricing: Custom fixed quote based on turnover.
   - URL: https://taxbyca.in/services/tax-audit

5. Project Reports & CMA Data:
   - Covers: Bank loan project reports, CMA data for CC/OD limits, term loan financial modeling, DSCR & financial projections for nationalized and private banks.
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹2,999.
   - URL: https://taxbyca.in/services/project-reports

6. TDS / TCS Compliance:
   - Covers: Quarterly TDS returns (Form 24Q, 26Q, 27EQ), 194J/194C/194I compliance, Form 16/16A generation, and TDS demand rectification.
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹1,499 per quarter.
   - URL: https://taxbyca.in/services/tds-compliance

7. ROC / Corporate Compliance:
   - Covers: Annual ROC filings (AOC-4, MGT-7/7A), DIR-3 KYC for directors, company share transfers, change of directors or registered office.
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹3,999 per year.
   - URL: https://taxbyca.in/services/roc-compliance

8. F&O / Capital Gain Taxation:
   - Covers: Equity, Intraday, Futures & Options (F&O) tax computation, Crypto taxation, loss set-off and carry-forward under Income Tax laws.
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹1,499.
   - URL: https://taxbyca.in/services/fno-capital-gain

9. Loan Documentation & Financial Statements:
   - Covers: Preparation of P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow statements, and loan dossier for MSME and business financing.
   - Pricing: Starting from ₹2,499.
   - URL: https://taxbyca.in/services/loan-documentation

10. Certificates:
    - Covers: Net worth certificates for visa/bank guarantees, turnover certificates, and utilization certificates.
    - Pricing: Starting from ₹1,499.
    - URL: https://taxbyca.in/services/ca-certificates
